title: Recipe 06 — RAG Pipeline (retrieval is configuration, not code)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Recipe 06 is the shape you reach for when the boundary of what the agent knows is the corpus you indexed.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the run beats. Note the corpus itself needs no key — mock/det embeds offline.

groups.title: Beat 1 · The spec — four blocks, no code

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “target: pipeline” — chunk → embed → store → retrieve → answer, as an explicit DAG.

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: “Two non-negotiables in the prompt: call Retrieve first, and refuse what the chunks don't cover.”

beats.label: Wire the retriever
beats.cue: “A deterministic embedder into an in-memory store. Swap either one and only one IR node changes — the prompt above is untouched.”

beats.label: Let it call Retrieve
beats.cue: “Without the alwaysAllow rule every retrieval prompts — which is never what you want in a RAG loop.”

beats.label: Add the chunker and the corpus
beats.cue: “Fixed 400-character windows over two inline documents. The corpus is spec surface, so what you indexed is reviewable in the same diff.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The spec is sugar; this JSON is the component DAG the compiler actually sees.”

verify.note: 39 lines of IR for target pipeline, redirected to scratch — the next beat opens it

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “Embedder, backend, chunk knobs and the documents, lowered to one flat record.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps and boots it: GREEN, no key needed.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “The corpus is baked in as a literal, right next to the chunker. That is why editing documents means a recompile.”

beats.label: Try crewhaus run first
beats.cue: “Deliberate rejection, exit 1: only cli and browser run straight from the spec. Pipeline is compile-first.”

verify.note: measured: `crewhaus run supports target: cli or browser (got "pipeline")`

beats.label: Boot the bundle
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Indexing runs once at process start, then the chat loop serves Retrieve calls against that store.”

verify.note: indexes offline (prints `[pipeline] indexed 2 chunks`), then needs Anthropic credentials for the loop

beats.label: Ask something the corpus covers
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Retrieve first, then two sentences with [N] citations — the numbering is the position in the retrieval result.”
beats.text: What target shapes does crewhaus support?

beats.label: Ask something it can't know
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Retrieve has no relevance floor — it still hands back the two nearest chunks. The refusal is the prompt's job, and this is where you find out whether it holds.”

verify.note: expect "I can only answer questions about the indexed docs."

beats.label: Exit the loop
beats.cue: [needs-key] “exit” returns to the shell.

groups.title: One more thing · N is the denominator for k

beats.label: Boot with the key scrubbed
beats.cue: “Same bundle, no credentials at all — chunk, embed and store still run to completion before anything asks the model for anything.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/agent.ts > live/boot.log 2>&1

verify.note: measured exit 1: the pipeline indexes, then the loop hits the provider credentials gate. Scrubbed explicitly because the Setup group already sourced .env into this shell.

beats.label: Read the chunk count
beats.cue: “`indexed 2 chunks` is the denominator. defaultK: 2 against N=2 hands the model the whole store on every question — grow the corpus before you grow k.”

verify.note: the boot line `[pipeline] indexed 2 chunks` — the recipe's Tuning-chunks section is about this number
